subject: I've been watching you
body:
Hi there,
Funny thing, you don't know me, but I know you really well by now.
Months back I slipped a little RAT onto your machine off a site you visited. full control since then. Cam, mic, everything you've typed, everywhere you've clicked. You never had a clue.
I've just been sitting back enjoying the show. And there's some stuff on here you REALLY don't want anyone else seeing. Zipped it all up for you, figured you'd want a look before you decide I'm bluffing. Open it if you don't believe me.
Here's how this goes. $1,200 in bitcoin to the wallet below, 48 hours, or everything goes out. Footage, files, your home address, all of it, straight to everyone you know and half the internet besides.
Wallet: 1KX7QzM4pLr9WgT2Yn8VsD5cJf3EbHq6Rt
Don't email me back. Don't bother with the cops either, they can't do anything about this. I'm still in there and I'll know everything.
